    • listChildren

      @Tool(name="alfresco_list_children", description="Lists the files and folders contained in an Alfresco folder, sorted by name, with paging. Start from -root- (Company Home), -my- (user home) or -shared- (Shared Files). \'totalItems\' is the number of children (-1 if unknown); while \'hasMoreItems\' is true, increase skipCount by the page size to read the next page.") public String listChildren(@ToolParam(description="Folder to list: a nodeRef (workspace://SpacesStore/<id>), a bare node id, or one of the aliases -root- (Company Home), -my- (user home folder), -shared- (Shared Files)") String nodeRef, @ToolParam(description="Number of items to skip (paging offset), 0 for the first page",required=false) Integer skipCount, @ToolParam(description="Page size, 1..1000 (default 100)",required=false) Integer maxItems)

    • createFolder

      @Tool(name="alfresco_create_folder", description="Creates a folder in Alfresco and returns it. Fails with ALREADY_EXISTS if the parent already contains a node with the same name.") public String createFolder(@ToolParam(description="Parent folder: a nodeRef, a bare node id or an alias (-root-, -my-, -shared-)") String parentRef, @ToolParam(description="Folder name") String name, @ToolParam(description="Optional typed metadata keyed by property name, e.g. {\"cm:title\":{\"multiValued\":false,\"values\":[{\"stringValue\":\"Budget\"}]}}. For lists use multiValued:true and zero or more typed values. Empty lists clear lists; {\"multiValued\":false,\"values\":[{\"nullValue\":true}]} clears a scalar. Omitted properties are unchanged. Each value has exactly one field: stringValue, integerValue, doubleValue, booleanValue, timestampMillis (epoch milliseconds), nodeRefValue or qnameValue. Types and cardinality must match the dictionary. Set the name with \'name\', never as cm:name.",required=false) Map<String,PropertyInput> properties)

    • createDocument

      @Tool(name="alfresco_create_document", description="Creates a document in an Alfresco folder and returns it. Pass text content in \'content\', or binary content base64-encoded in \'contentBase64\' (not both). The mimetype is guessed from the name extension unless given. Fails with ALREADY_EXISTS if the name is taken.") public String createDocument(@ToolParam(description="Parent folder: a nodeRef, a bare node id or an alias (-root-, -my-, -shared-)") String parentRef, @ToolParam(description="Document name including the extension, e.g. notes.md") String name, @ToolParam(description="Text content (UTF-8)",required=false) String content, @ToolParam(description="Binary content encoded in base64",required=false) String contentBase64, @ToolParam(description="Mimetype, e.g. text/markdown; guessed from the name when omitted",required=false) String mimetype, @ToolParam(description="Optional typed metadata keyed by property name, e.g. {\"cm:title\":{\"multiValued\":false,\"values\":[{\"stringValue\":\"Budget\"}]}}. For lists use multiValued:true and zero or more typed values. Empty lists clear lists; {\"multiValued\":false,\"values\":[{\"nullValue\":true}]} clears a scalar. Omitted properties are unchanged. Each value has exactly one field: stringValue, integerValue, doubleValue, booleanValue, timestampMillis (epoch milliseconds), nodeRefValue or qnameValue. Types and cardinality must match the dictionary. Set the name with \'name\', never as cm:name.",required=false) Map<String,PropertyInput> properties)
